_howto: HOW TO ADD A VIDEO BY HAND: add an object to 'videos': {"url": "<TikTok video URL>",
'views' is a plain number. The site formats it (86400 -> 86.4K) and pins the three
highest-viewed videos to the top of the feed itself. There is no 'pinned' flag.
The upload date is encoded in the video id: new Date(Number(BigInt(id) >> 32n) * 1000).
THUMBNAIL: save a ~360px wide webp at thumbs/<video-id>.webp (TikTok CDN URLs expire,
so a local copy is mandatory). A missing thumb degrades to a styled dark card.
Normally none of this is needed: scripts/refresh-videos.mjs does it hourly.
_auto: Auto-refreshed hourly by scripts/refresh-videos.mjs. Hand-edited "note" text is preserved by video id; "views" is re-pulled from TikTok (monotonic: never decreases). New/removed videos ship immediately; view-count-only changes are written at most every 6 hours to limit deploy churn. _lastRefresh records the last successful write.
